# vendor/ — vendored reference data (READ-ONLY)

Invariant 8 (CLAUDE.md): files under `vendor/` are **read-only** — never edited by
hand or by mapping changes. They change only by re-running the generating tool
against a new upstream source (a new spreadsheet version, a live codelist sync, a
new published schema rev), reviewed as an ordinary PR.

| Path | Contents | Generated by |
|---|---|---|
| `national-spreadsheet/field-catalog.json` | DE inventory per formality template + aggregated per-DE element index | `tools/spreadsheet-parser` (spec 0001) |
| `national-spreadsheet/annotations.json` | nauticAi/Acmeship source-hint annotations — coverage-matrix seed | `tools/spreadsheet-parser` |
| `national-spreadsheet/codelists/` | Codelist snapshots (EN/FI/SV, national flags, DE references) + `index.json`. **Fallback source only since spec 0023**: `nemo/hub/codelists.json` is authoritative wherever the web publishes values; the spreadsheet remains the source for `hs_cargo_item` (empty on the web) and the 18 lists absent from the page | `tools/spreadsheet-parser` |

| `nemo/mig/2.0.1.0/` | All 30 MIG 2.0.1.0 formality JSON schemas | `tools/nemo-schemas` (spec 0005) |
| `nemo/openapi/` | Declarant (v1.1.8), Port, Location Service, Hazmat OpenAPI specs — extracted from the hub's ReDoc pages. NB: upstream's hazmat spec mistitles itself "Location service."; content is the hazmat API | `tools/nemo-schemas` |
| `nemo/hub/` | Hub metadata: `de-index.json`, `codelist-to-formality.json`, `config.json`, `rcg.json`; **`codelists.json`** (authoritative hub codelist values, 132 non-empty lists / 6 640 entries, FI-preferred flags — spec 0023) and **`hs-map.json`** (statistics group → representative HS6, spec 0023) | `tools/nemo-schemas` |
| `nemo/manifest.json` | Source URL + sha256 for every `nemo/` file | `tools/nemo-schemas` |

Every file embeds (spreadsheet outputs) or is listed with (`nemo/manifest.json`) the
`sha256` of its upstream source — outputs are deterministic given the same input.

Still to vendor (deferred to the cargo/mapping spec — see docs/04): the hub
**Customs Vessel Type Map** (`customs-vessel-type-linked.html`, UNECE Rec 28
vessel type → Finnish `customs_ship_type`; both endpoint codelists are already
vendored). HTML-only page, parsed like the hub codelists/HS-map pages.
